description: Email authentication DNS records for a domain: DMARC policy (p, sp, pct, rua), SPF record and its all-mechanism, and DKIM public keys for a selector you give or for 8 common selectors (revoked keys and CNAME-delegated keys are reported). Reads the published DNS records only; it does not check alignment against a real message. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

selector.description: DKIM selector such as google, selector1 or k1 (optional; common selectors are tried when empty)
